To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) we propose new definitions of AE schemes in the presence of leveled leakages and nonce misuses, (ii) we show that the definitions of INT-PTX and IND-CPA do not imply INT-CTXT in the presence of leaking, and that INT-PTXT does not imply INT-PTXT in the presence leaking and nonce misuse, and (iii) we propose a new mode of AE that is efficient and offers security in the presence of both leakages and nonce reuse
FEMALE offers the best trade-off between efficiency and security guarantees in the presence of leakage, while AEDT offers the best trade-offs in the black-box model.

FEMALE is a new AE scheme with leakage-resilience in the leveled setting, AEDT is a new AE construction with misuse-resistance in the leveled setting (but not in the black-box one), and that the security landscape of AE schemes in the presence of leakage is different from the one in the black-box case.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions.
the design and security analysis of AE modes of operation that are robust to leakages and misuse.
the design of AE schemes that offer security in the presence of leakage and misuse, and with the study of the security landscape of AE schemes in this setting.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

FEMALE offers a good tradeoff between security and efficiency in the presence of misuses and leakages, whereas AEDT offers the strongest possible form of misuse resistance while being efficient in the black-box case.
our definitions and constructions are a step forward towards the design of AE schemes with the best possible security guarantees, while maintaining appealing efficiency properties.
the leakage setting is more complex than the black-box setting: it is possible to achieve stronger forms of misuse resistance, but the landscape is richer and more complex.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
FEMALE is the first authenticated encryption scheme that supports leveled implementations and is proven secure under our strongest definition.

we provide a framework for defining and analyzing leakage-resilient AE schemes that are resilient against a wide range of attacks, and provide constructions that are efficient enough for practical use.

FEMALE is a new AE mode that offers the strongest level of security guarantees that is achievable in the presence of both leakages and misuse, and AEDDT is a new AE scheme that is fully leakage resilient, and fully misuse resistant in a black-box setting.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, in the presence of misuses and leakages, the efficiency of AE schemes can be achieved at the price of a loss of security guarantees.
it is possible to design AE schemes that are robust against both side-channel leakages, and misuse, without sacrificing efficiency.
, in the presence of leakage and misuse, the security guarantees of a mode of operation cannot be fully characterized by its black-box guarantees.
